title: The user reminds the agent of something it skipped; it then needs the user
expected: The schema docs are listed once while open, become an action for the user when the agent asks them to run the generator, and are closed when the user has run it.

steps.user: Add an index on orders.created_at and update the schema docs.

check.why: the schema docs are asked for and not updated

steps.agent: You're right. Before I edit docs/schema.md: it is generated by `pnpm docs:schema`, so I should regenerate rather than hand-edit. The generator needs a database connection I don't have here. Can you run `pnpm docs:schema` on your machine?

check.why: the reminder is the same request, not a second one
running the generator is for the user to do

steps.agent: Good, then the index and its docs are both done.

check.why: nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
nothing is waiting on the user
